source_artifacts.description: Must include both the artifact to audit and the brand canon artifact(s) to audit against. A run with no canon reference is malformed input, not a valid audit request.

prior_run.description: Path to prior DRIFT_REGISTER.md or BRAND_QA_REPORT.md/checkpoint. Required when mode is UPDATE.

canon_refs.description: Explicit pointers to the approved canon sections/artifacts (strategy, verbal identity, visual identity) relevant to this artifact. If empty or missing entirely, the run must return BLOCKED at the canon gate (SKILL.md step 1).
